feeds.term: (lecanemab OR donanemab OR "anti-amyloid" OR "tau-targeting" OR trontinemab) AND ("clinical trial"[Publication Type] OR phase OR efficacy)

feeds.title: 机制 · 基础研究
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.title: 诊断 · 生物标志物
feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.title: 预防 · 生活方式
feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.title: 新手村 · 入门综述
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
drug.zh: 机器学习模型可基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征准确分类淀粉样阳性人群的tau状态。

drug.title: Cognitive-enhancing drugs in Phase II clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease: emerging therapeutic candidates.
drug.zh: II期认知增强药试验多数疗效有限，亟需更精准的靶点与试验设计。

drug.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Chalcones in Alzheimer's Disease: Mechanistic Insights and SAR Perspectives.
drug.zh: 查尔酮母核经卤代或三氟甲基修饰可增强AD多靶点抑制活性，为MTDLs设计提供SAR依据。

drug.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样单抗对早期AD疗效与安全性差异显著，临床决策需个体化权衡。

drug.title: Streamlining eligibility assessment for Alzheimer's disease-modifying therapies: Prediction of MMSE scores using the digital clock and recall.
drug.zh: 数字时钟与回忆测试结合机器学习可高效预测MMSE评分，简化AD疗法资格评估。

drug.title: Six-month real-world amyloid PET outcomes after lecanemab: Greater amyloid reduction at the MCI stage than in dementia.
drug.zh: 真实世界数据显示仑卡奈单抗在MCI期降淀粉样蛋白效果优于痴呆期。

drug.title: The Clearance-Centered Bottleneck in Alzheimer's Disease: From Coupled Glymphatic-Lymphatic Circuits to Therapeutic Opportunities.
drug.zh: 提出以清除为中心的新框架，揭示AD是脑类淋巴-淋巴回路多节点失效的瓶颈。

drug.title: Nanomedicine targeting neuroinflammatory pathways in Alzheimer's disease: a new frontier in inflammopharmacology.
drug.zh: 纳米药物可精准调控神经炎症通路，为阿尔茨海默病治疗开辟新前沿。

mech.title: Proteomic comparison of hippocampal neurofibrillary tangles in PART, intermediate Alzheimer's disease and advanced Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: PART中缠结蛋白组与AD差异显著，提示Aβ病理改变tau聚集机制。

mech.title: The Glial Autophagy-Lysosomal-Inflammation Axis in Alzheimer's Disease: a Unifying Mechanistic Framework.
mech.zh: 胶质自噬-溶酶体通路受损驱动神经炎症，构成阿尔茨海默病统一机制框架。

mech.title: Biomarker-Based Diagnosis and Care Pathways for Alzheimer's Disease in the Era of Disease-Modifying Treatments: A Consensus Statement by Belgian Experts.
mech.zh: 比利时专家共识：AD诊疗须以生物标志物确诊淀粉样病变，并重构医疗体系以适配DMT时代。

mech.title: New Genetic Associations Between Alzheimer's Disease and Its Key Risk Factors.
mech.zh: 阿尔茨海默病与关键风险因素共享九个基因的十六个显著变异，其中APOE、ABCA1和TOMM40关联最强。

mech.title: Exploring longitudinal relationships among Alzheimer's disease biomarkers.
mech.zh: 血浆生物标志物基线值较其变化率更能预测AD关键结局的进展速度。

mech.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
mech.zh: 基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征构建的机器学习模型可有效预测淀粉样阳性人群的tau病理状态。

mech.title: DNAJB6a deficiency induces tau pathology through IRE1α-Xbp1-induced mitochondria dysfunction.
mech.zh: DNAJB6a缺失经IRE1α-Xbp1通路致线粒体功能障碍，引发tau蛋白病理。

mech.title: Peripheral Administration of isoD7-Aβ Exacerbates Motor Deficits and Tau Pathology in P301S Mice.
mech.zh: 外周注射isoD7-Aβ加剧P301S小鼠运动障碍及tau病理，提示外周淀粉样负荷可经Akt/GSK-3β通路恶化中枢病变。

dx.title: Biomarker-Based Diagnosis and Care Pathways for Alzheimer's Disease in the Era of Disease-Modifying Treatments: A Consensus Statement by Belgian Experts.
dx.zh: 比利时专家共识：AD诊断须以生物标志物确证淀粉样病理，血液检测可提升可及性但需防过度诊断。

dx.title: Motor performance and its association with Alzheimer's-related biomarkers: a systematic review.
dx.zh: 阿尔茨海默病相关生物标志物与运动功能显著关联，或可预警早期认知衰退。

dx.title: Exploring longitudinal relationships among Alzheimer's disease biomarkers.
dx.zh: 血浆生物标志物基线值比其变化率更能预测AD关键结局的进展速率。

dx.title: Anemia, iron deficiency, and blood biomarkers for Alzheimer disease: clinical interpretation and dementia risk stratification.
dx.zh: 贫血与铁缺乏状态显著影响AD血液生物标志物解读及痴呆风险分层。

dx.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
dx.zh: 基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征构建的机器学习模型可有效分类淀粉样阳性人群的tau病理状态。

dx.title: Alzheimer's disease-related β-amyloid deposition prediction based on plasma biomarkers, ApoE4, and CDR with a machine learning approach.
dx.journal: Computer methods and programs in biomedi
dx.zh: 机器学习结合血浆标志物、ApoE4及CDR可低成本预测脑内β-淀粉样蛋白沉积。

dx.title: Peripheral Administration of isoD7-Aβ Exacerbates Motor Deficits and Tau Pathology in P301S Mice.
dx.zh: 外周注射isoD7-Aβ加剧P301S小鼠运动缺陷及tau病理，提示外周淀粉样负荷可经Akt/GSK-3β通路恶化中枢病变。

dx.title: Validation of Plasma p-tau217 as a Biomarker of Prodromal Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217经LUMIPULSE检测可有效识别前驱期阿尔茨海默病，支持临床早期诊断应用。

prev.title: Multi-organ structural and functional deficits in association with long COVID: a population-based case-control study.
prev.zh: 长新冠患者存在多器官结构与功能缺陷，且与感染及症状持续时间显著相关。

prev.title: Hospital Electronic Health Records as a research resource: data linkage, national scale-up, and five-year Impact of the National Centre for Healthy Ageing Data Platform.
prev.zh: 澳大利亚建成百万人级医院电子病历研究平台，实现数据快速共享与AI文本挖掘。

prev.title: Plasma proteomics reveals molecular overlap between physical activity and dementia risk.
prev.zh: 血浆蛋白质组学揭示体力活动降低痴呆风险的分子通路与认知衰退重叠。

prev.title: Perceived stress as a mediator between negative life events and psychosocial quality of life during the menopausal transition: A path analysis.
prev.zh: 围绝经期女性心理社会生活质量受负性生活事件影响，且感知压力起完全中介作用。

prev.title: Mediating role of metabolic factors in the association between dietary habits and the onset of type 2 diabetes: a population-based Panasonic cohort study 19.
prev.zh: 该研究揭示快速进食与不吃早餐通过肥胖及代谢异常部分介导2型糖尿病风险。

prev.title: The Oral-Brain Axis: Mechanistic Insights Linking Periodontitis With Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Diseases.
prev.zh: 牙周炎通过口腔-大脑轴驱动神经炎症，成为阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病的可干预风险因素。

prev.title: AI-based predictive biomarkers for chronic neurological diseases: the rAIdD prospective, multicenter, observational study protocol.
prev.zh: 该研究方案提出利用AI与可穿戴设备整合多模态数据，为慢神经病（含AD）建立预测性数字生物标志物。

prev.title: Transforming Research and Clinical Knowledge in Older Veterans with Acute Traumatic Brain Injury: A Longitudinal Observational Study.
prev.zh: 老年退伍军人急性脑外伤后痴呆风险高，需系统化纵向研究以优化干预。

intro.title: Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases: pathogenic mechanisms and therapeutic strategies.
intro.zh: 大脑发炎会加重老年痴呆和帕金森病，这篇综述帮你看懂病因，知道未来药该往哪儿使劲。

intro.title: Network Biology of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Neurodegenerative Disorders: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Strategies.
intro.zh: 这篇综述把老年痴呆等脑病看成一张互相牵连的“坏网”，告诉你治病不能只盯一个点，得从整体下手。

intro.title: Worry and Anxiety in the Era of Early Diagnosis and Disease Modifying Treatment for Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，在阿尔茨海默病早期查出和用药时，患者和家属的担心焦虑该怎么应对，帮普通人少走弯路、心里有底。

intro.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
intro.zh: 简单说，就是科学家对比了几种治早期老年痴呆的新药，看哪个更管用、更安全，帮您和家人选药时心里有底。

intro.title: Glycopolymers as emerging modulators of Amyloid-β aggregation: structure-activity relationships and therapeutic potential.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用糖分子做成的“胶水”去粘住大脑里的坏蛋白，防止它们抱团捣乱，帮普通人了解未来可能延缓老年痴呆的新药方向。

intro.title: Oral Microbial Extracellular Vesicles as Novel Mediators of Alzheimer's Pathogenesis: A Critical Review of the Periodontal-Brain Axis.
intro.zh: 简单说就是：牙周细菌会释放微小“快递包”进入大脑，引发炎症，可能加重老年痴呆；所以好好刷牙、护好牙龈，或许能帮大脑防病。

intro.title: Peripheral and Central miRNA Signatures in Alzheimer's Disease: Tissue-Specific Variability, Sex-Associated Differences, and Implications for Blood-Based Biomarkers.
intro.zh: 这篇研究想告诉大家，未来可能靠抽血查一种叫“微小RNA”的小分子，来更早发现阿尔茨海默病，但男女和身体部位不同会影响结果，得小心用。

intro.title: Analysis of the Efficacy of Acetylcholinesterase Inhibitors in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease, Literature Review.
intro.zh: 这文章就是讲治老年痴呆的常用药到底管不管用，帮家属明白吃药能拖住啥、拖不住啥。
